Q1.label: Q1 (Urgent, Important)
Q1.title: For Your Action or Response
Q1.description: Messages requiring immediate owner attention, decision, action, or response.

reasons.reason: The staging environment is experiencing a service outage (500 errors), which is a significant operational risk requiring immediate technical intervention.
The staging environment is down, requiring immediate action to update credentials and restart the worker to restore service.
This is a security alert regarding a password change for a critical account (AWS root). If unauthorized, it represents a significant security risk that requires immediate personal intervention.

This is a security notification regarding a new login. While important for security awareness, it requires no action if the login was intentional, and as an automated notification, it is best archived unless the user identifies it as unauthorized.
A production error in the checkout process is a critical operational risk that requires immediate technical intervention.
The email requires Sam's specific approval on pricing copy by a deadline (the 12th) to unblock the rest of the launch week shipping process.
The candidate has a competing offer deadline on the 19th, requiring a timely response to maintain the recruitment process.
The sender is requesting completion of a previously discussed task before an upcoming call, implying immediate time sensitivity and relevance to work priorities.
The email requires a review and signature of a legal document (SAFE) by a specific deadline (Friday), making it both important and time-sensitive.

The email requires a review and corrections by a specific deadline (Monday) for an upcoming board meeting, making it both important and time-sensitive.

Q2.label: Q2 (Important, Not Urgent)
Q2.title: Schedule / Follow Up
Q2.description: Important messages that require attention but can be scheduled, deferred, or followed up later.

reasons.reason: The email is a status update confirming that a previous issue (staging being down) has been resolved and the system is recovering.
The invoice is important for contractor payment, but the sender explicitly stated 'no rush' and 'ideally this week,' indicating it does not require immediate action today.
This is a standing preference for future scheduling. While important for context, it requires no immediate action or response, and the information can be stored/archived for future reference.
This is a standing preference/instruction for future workflow rather than an immediate task or actionable legal matter requiring a response.

Q3.title: Delegate
Q3.description: Time-sensitive messages that do not require the owner's direct involvement and can be delegated.

The sender is requesting a schedule change for a meeting occurring this week, requiring a quick response to confirm availability.
